name: final-follow-up-verification
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp -a audit-data/follow-up-input/. .; mkdir -p current-audit/source; cp followup-source/*.ts current-audit/source/; cp audit-data/resource-run.ts current-audit/; cp followup-source/validate-tools.ts current-audit/; bun -e 'import{readdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync}from"node:fs";import{createHash}from"node:crypto";const h=Object.fromEntries(readdirSync("current-audit/source").map(n=>[n,createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync("current-audit/source/"+n)).digest("hex")]));writeFileSync("current-audit/source-manifest.json",JSON.stringify(h));console.log("FOLLOW_SOURCE_INPUT "+JSON.stringify(h))'; bun current-audit/validate-tools.ts current-audit .; bun followup-source/regression-audit.ts . > current-audit/receipt.log; bun -e 'import{readFileSync}from"node:fs";const tag="REGRESSION_RECEIPT_AUDIT ",line=readFileSync("current-audit/receipt.log","utf8").split("\n").find(l=>l.startsWith(tag));if(!line)throw Error("missing audited result");const r=JSON.parse(line.slice(tag.length)),range=a=>a.length?[Math.min(...a),Math.max(...a)]:null,side=(c,s)=>({passed:c[s+"Pass"],processMs:range(c.pairs.map(p=>p[s].wallMs)),rootMs:range(c.pairs.map(p=>p[s].rootMs).filter(n=>typeof n==="number")),nativeTestPasses:c.pairs.map(p=>p[s].pass??0).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),maxNativeCaseMs:Math.max(0,...c.pairs.flatMap(p=>(p[s].cases??[]).flatMap(l=>[...l.matchAll(/\[([\d.]+)ms\]/g)].map(m=>Number(m[1])))))}),primary=r.cohorts.filter(c=>[r.primaryEpyc,r.primaryOther].includes(c.name));const summary={auditSourceSha256:r.auditSourceSha256,requiredCpuCoverage:r.requiredCpuCoverage,primaryEpyc:r.primaryEpyc,primaryOther:r.primaryOther,majorityRegressions:r.majorityRegressions,skipped:r.skips,cohorts:r.cohorts.map(c=>({name:c.name,cpu:c.cpu,mode:c.mode,base:side(c,"base"),candidate:side(c,"candidate"),candidateOnlyLosses:c.candidateOnlyLosses})),primaryPhaseExample:primary.map(c=>({name:c.name,base:c.pairs[0].base.phases.map(p=>({phase:p.phase,ms:p.ms})),candidate:c.pairs[0].candidate.phases.map(p=>({phase:p.phase,ms:p.ms}))})),inputHashes:r.inputHashes};console.log("REGRESSION_FINAL_SUMMARY "+JSON.stringify(summary,null,2));if(!r.requiredCpuCoverage||r.majorityRegressions.length)process.exitCode=1;'
